name: Wait for an app /healthz
description: Poll a URL until it answers (any HTTP status below 500, like the App Cloud probe, or 2xx with strict) and report the status, attempts and the last error. Use after starting a server or publishing an app instead of a curl retry loop.

url.description: http(s):// URL to poll, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8732/healthz

timeoutSec.description: give up after this long, default 30, at most 540

strict.description: require a 2xx answer instead of anything below 500

outputs: { ok, status, attempts, elapsedMs } or { ok: false, lastError, error } when it never came up
